parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Client-generated key (a UUID per logical submit; a retry reuses it), 1 to 128
printable ASCII characters. The same key with the same method, path and body
replays the stored answer with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; with a different
request it is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. Missing: 400
`idempotency-key-required`; malformed: 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: The SKU (1..64 characters, no whitespace, control characters or `/`).
